title: Stride Two: the sock test

product.name: Stride Two
product.one_liner: neutral daily running shoe with a knit upper and a wide toe box

audience: casual runners 25-45 whose shoes rub at the little toe

presenter.description: fictional woman, mid thirties, running kit, hallway; generated, not based on anyone

hook.text: Your shoe's too narrow. Here's the test.
hook.why: Offers a quick self-diagnosis; the viewer wants the test more than the shoe.

style: hallway and pavement phone footage, overcast daylight, handheld

shots.visual: Presenter pulls the insole out of an old shoe and stands on it; her toes spill over the edge
shots.caption:
your shoe's too narrow. here's the test
AI-generated ad
shots.voiceover: Your shoe's too narrow. Here's the test.

prompt.subject: a bare foot standing on a thin grey shoe insole on a wooden hallway floor, toes overhanging the edge
prompt.action: the foot settles onto the insole and the little toe spills over the side
prompt.camera: handheld, high angle pointed at the floor

shots.visual: Presenter to camera holding the old shoe, pointing at the worn-through spot by the little toe
shots.caption: that hole by the little toe? width, not mileage
shots.voiceover: Toes hanging over the insole means the shoe is too narrow. That hole? Width, not mileage.

prompt.subject: fictional woman in her mid thirties in running kit holding up a worn running shoe, pointing at a frayed spot on the side
prompt.action: she turns the shoe to the lens and taps the worn spot

shots.visual: New shoe's insole on the floor, same foot, toes inside the edge; then the knit upper stretched with two thumbs
shots.caption: wide toe box. knit gives, doesn't rub.
shots.voiceover: Same foot on the Stride Two insole: toes inside the line. The knit upper stretches, so nothing rubs.

prompt.subject: the same bare foot standing on a new white insole, toes fully inside the edge, then two thumbs stretching a grey knit shoe upper
prompt.action: the foot settles on the insole, cut to thumbs pulling the knit upper outward and letting it spring back

shots.visual: Pavement: presenter jogs toward camera, close on the forefoot splaying on landing
shots.camera: low, static, presenter runs toward lens
shots.caption: toes spread on landing
shots.voiceover: On the road your toes spread when you land. This shoe leaves room for that.

prompt.subject: low angle of a woman's feet in grey knit running shoes jogging toward the camera on a wet pavement
prompt.action: she runs toward the lens, each foot lands and the forefoot flattens and widens slightly

shots.visual: Shoe on a kitchen scale, box label showing the width fitting; size chart held to camera
shots.caption: the width is on the box. check yours.
shots.voiceover: The fitting is printed on the box. Check before you run.

shots.visual: Presenter laces up at the door and nods at the camera
shots.caption: do the insole test tonight. link below.
shots.voiceover: Do the insole test tonight. Link below.

prompt.subject: the fictional woman crouched at a front door lacing a grey knit running shoe, looking up at the lens
prompt.action: she pulls the laces tight, stands and nods toward the bottom of the frame

claims.text: the fitting is printed on the box
claims.evidence: box label of the shipping product; photo in the campaign folder

cta.text: Do the insole test tonight. Link below.
cta.on_screen: do the insole test tonight. link below.

notes: No injury-prevention or 'podiatrist-approved' wording; the insole test is a fit check, not medical advice.
Running shots are generated: the shoe silhouette must match the real product, so attach product photos as reference frames.
